subject: economics
objective: What are the unemployment and participation rates?
instruction: In Harbourview the labour force is 910,000 and 858,000 people are employed. The survey did not record the size of the working-age population. Unemployed = labour force - employed. Unemployment rate = unemployed / labour force. Participation rate = labour force / working-age population. Employment-population ratio = employed / working-age population. Required: unemployment rate, participation rate, employment population ratio.
